Nepal PM Balen Shah Visits India, Receives $1.6 Billion Aid Package

Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah concluded his first visit to India, during which India announced a $1.6 billion aid package for Nepal. The two countries signed eight Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) spanning sectors including space, security, health, and governance. The visit was characterized by India rolling out a welcome for the Nepalese leader, who reportedly chose India for his first bilateral visit over China.
